notes: 0.3.50：修「同步内容 → 技能市场台账」两个勾选项的 id。条目元素本来是 {id, src} 对象，之前把整个对象当 id 传下去，写进 config-sync-scope.json 时被序列化成 "[object Object]"：面板上看得到 installed.json / panel.json 两项，但单独取消勾选永远记不住，还会被「排除项只认本机真实存在」的清理逻辑判成无效键。改成取 f.id（文件名）后，勾选与排除都能正常落盘、跨机读回一致。
notesEn: 0.3.50: fixes the ids of the two skill-market ledger checkboxes under "Sync content". The entries are {id, src} objects, but the whole object was passed as the id, so config-sync-scope.json serialized it as "[object Object]": both installed.json / panel.json showed up in the panel, yet unchecking either one never stuck and the "only real local ids" cleanup dropped the key. Taking f.id (the file name) makes checks and exclusions persist and round-trip across machines.
